typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CPSUIArchiveFolder as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveScrubFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveTriggerFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIDncFolder as string (),
	CPSUIDncScrubFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIDncTriggerFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIFileName as string (),
	CPSUIScrubFileName as string (),
	CPSUITriggerFileName as string (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	StagingDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'\' AS DATA',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSDNC
PDSDNC sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = DATA)) ~> FlatFileDestination
